text:
Priya: Heads-up: deploy-bot can't promote canary -> prod. Cut window in 40m.
Priya: CI failing during artifact restore: multiple runners error creating symlinks when unpacking artifacts.tgz.
Tom: example from bk job 4021:
```
+ tar -xzf artifacts.tgz
tar: tools/bin -> ../bin: Cannot create symlink
ERROR: extraction failed
```
Tom: Also seeing `lease_acquire_timeout` in deploy-bot logs contacting artifact-indexer.
deploy-bot: Promotion attempt 1 -> stalled. Reason: lease_acquire_timeout on artifact-indexer (retries exhausted).
ops-jen: Oncall. Confirmed a kernel patch and NFS mount option change landed this morning on cache hosts. That matches the symlink failures. Reverting mounts/kernel across the fleet during the window is risky (~25m + rollout).
release-coordinator: Customer-facing release notes need to go out at cut. Recommend manual pin to last-green to meet commit window and avoid partial rollout risk. We'll clearly document rationale.
Priya: If we manual-promote, we need: who runs it, exact command for audit, release-note text, and infra ticket for follow-up.
Tom: I can do the manual promote and update notes. Command I'll run:
```
/deploy promote --image sha:9ad7f2 --env prod --reason "manual-pin-cache-unpack-symlink-fail"
```
ops-jen: I'll open INFRA-2211 and attach failing job ids (bk/4021,bk/4032,bk/4048), host list and kernel diff. We'll schedule a rollback out-of-band and include a postmortem.
Priya: QA, can you smoke the critical paths once promoted? We need uploads and auth validated before we mark release shipped.
qa-bot: Queued quick smoke: uploads, auth, search. ETA ~10m after promote. Will report results here.
Tom: Executing manual promote now. /deploy promote --image sha:9ad7f2 --env prod --reason "manual-pin-cache-unpack-symlink-fail"
deploy-bot: Manual promotion requested by Tom. Initiating rollout -> 25% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100%. Health checks: OK. Promotion complete. new prod image sha:9ad7f2. :white_check_mark:
qa-bot: Smoke results: uploads OK, auth OK, search degraded (timeout on a single shard) — investigating; could be unrelated flake.
Priya: Release note draft: "Pinned to sha:9ad7f2 due to CI artifact extraction failures (symlink creation) after cache host kernel/NFS change; INFRA-2211 opened for rollback and postmortem. QA smoke run passed core flows; one degraded search shard under investigation."
Tom: I'll push the exact promote command and reasoning to the release checklist and add the deploy-bot log snippet referencing `lease_acquire_timeout`.
ops-jen: INFRA-2211 created and assigned to infra-kernel team. Will propose an off-window rollback plan and additional mount tests to prevent auto-merge of kernel patches during active change windows.
Priya: Agreed add a pre-merge gating test on cache hosts for symlink handling. Also add an entry to run the smoke suite in CI after infra changes.
release-coordinator: I'll include the pin note in the customer release note and tag legal/comms if needed.
Priya: Closing this cut-thread — follow-ups tracked: INFRA-2211, docs PR with promote command, QA follow-up on search. Thanks everyone for quick decision.
__notes: Slack threads must be a single continuous string, messages in chronological order, each prefixed with sender name.
